title: Minecraft Just Opened a Door to a Whole New World
summary:
Imagine digging in Minecraft and suddenly falling into a world nobody has ever seen before. That's basically what's happening! At Minecraft Live, the game makers announced a brand-new dimension called The Sift. It's the first completely new world in 15 years. The last one, The End, arrived way back in 2011.

The Sift will show up first in Minecraft Dungeons II, a spin-off game coming out September 29. Then it comes to regular Minecraft next year. What's inside? Blue bunnies! That's all we know so far, and honestly, that's enough to be excited.

There's more. Underground ice caves are coming too. They're rare, they're full of ore, and they have glowing ice crystals. A new mob called the frozen zombie lives there. He throws ice balls at you, and if he hits you enough times, you freeze. But guess what? You can throw the ice balls right back. Mostly at your friends.

Also, Minecraft is finally coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on October 27. So grab your pickaxe — big things are coming.
why_it_matters: If you play Minecraft, the game you already know is about to get a mysterious new world to explore — and something brand new to talk about with your friends at school.

background_read: Minecraft is a building game made by a Swedish studio called Mojang, which was bought by Microsoft in 2014. It is one of the best-selling video games ever made.
Minecraft worlds are called dimensions. The Overworld is where you start, the Nether is a hot and dangerous place, and The End is a dark world with a dragon boss.
Game makers often share big news at online events like Minecraft Live, so players all around the world can watch the announcements together at the same time.
Article_Structure: WHO: The makers of Minecraft, who shared the news at their Minecraft Live event
WHAT: A brand-new dimension called The Sift, plus new ice caves, a frozen zombie mob, and a Nintendo Switch 2 release
WHERE: Announced at Minecraft Live; The Sift arrives first in Minecraft Dungeons II, then in regular Minecraft, and Minecraft comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on October 27
WHY: It is the first completely new Minecraft world in 15 years, so players finally get a whole new place to explore

perspectives.description: A new dimension after 15 years is huge news, and even one detail like blue bunnies is enough to make fans start guessing about what else is hiding in The Sift.
We only know about blue bunnies so far, and the Sift does not reach regular Minecraft until next year, so some players worry the wait will be long and the new world might be small.
For players on the new console, the biggest news is simply that Minecraft is finally arriving on October 27, so they can join in without switching devices.
